source_scope.member_policy: Exactly one retained XML member; no archive siblings are in scope.

source_attribute_policy: Every source attribute is retained exactly in source-accountability.json. TEI uses only standard attributes for source type, numbering, rendition, page facsimile, and scripture target; no foreign tracking attributes are introduced.
text_policy: Preserve source element text, child order, child tails, full descendant text hashes, source IDs where present, and deterministic TEI IDs where source IDs are absent.
